name: E1.31 (sACN)
description: Generic E1.31 / sACN (ANSI E1.31-2018) unicast output on UDP 5568 to pixel controllers added by IP, 170 RGB LEDs per universe, Stream_Terminated on shutdown. Written from the public E1.31 standard. Untested: nobody on the project owns an E1.31 receiver. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/e131.md.
